identity.name: Time Provider Registration via Registry Modification
identity.summary: An attacker modifies the Windows registry to register a malicious time provider, which is a technique used for persistence and system manipulation. Cortex should detect the suspicious registry modific
identity.description: An attacker modifies the Windows registry to register a malicious time provider, which is a technique used for persistence and system manipulation. Cortex should detect the suspicious registry modification and process execution.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

payload.code:
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\W32Time\TimeProviders\{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}" /v "Name" /t REG_SZ /d "CustomTimeProvider" /f
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\W32Time\TimeProviders\{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}" /v "DllName" /t REG_SZ /d "C:\\temp\\malicious.dll" /f
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\W32Time\TimeProviders\{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}" /v "Enabled" /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\W32Time\TimeProviders\{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}" /v "InputTime" /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\W32Time\TimeProviders\{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}" /v "OutputTime" /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious Time Provider Registered
biocs.description: A registry key under W32Time\TimeProviders is modified with a custom name and DLL path
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'W32Time\\TimeProviders'
| filter action_file_path contains 'DllName'
| filter action_file_path contains 'Name'
| filter action_file_path contains 'CustomTimeProvider'
